newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croat Podravka says makes headway in consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Croat Podravka says makes headway in consolidation.

text.p: Croatia's leading food-processing group Podravka d.d. said on Tuesday it was making headway in corporate reorganisation and financial consolidation.
"We have moved ahead in our plans for restructuring in order to achieve a profitable growth," spokesman Zeljko Pazic told Reuters by telephone.
Podravka is situated in Koprivnica in the rural Podravina region, some 100 km (62 miles) northeast of the capital Zagreb.
Although its main food-processing business is profitable, the group had accumulated losses in some parts such as distillery Segestica, a glass factory and wickerworks.
"We have sold five loss-making subsidiaries," Pazic said, adding Podravka now had to deal with surplus workers.
It made a loss of 135 million kuna in 1995 and covered it from reserves.

The price of Podravka's shares on Zagreb's bourse has soared to 315 kuna this year from 231 on December 31, 1996 as the market picked up rumours about its restructuring progress. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
